summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill in async_task_completion domain with unique method_family (future_result_access) and stage (result_collection). It does not semantically match any existing skill in the registry, which contains only GRPO loss formulation and custom reward function skills from a different domain (loss_computation, reward_computation). The peer_candidates represent related but separate Future manipulation capabilities (exception inspection, callback registration, executor submission) that do not subsume or conflict with this result retrieval skill.
